WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        CAST(SUM(CAST(i.qty AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * i.unit_price) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS revenue
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'order_items') }} i
    JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'products') }} p
        ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    revenue
FROM product_revenue
ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id
LIMIT 5

explanation: This procedure ranks products by total sales value, calculated as quantity times unit price across all order line items. It keeps the five products with the highest revenue, breaking any ties by product ID, and saves them to a table. The procedure rebuilds that table from scratch on each run.
